# InspectApedia

> InspectApedia is a comprehensive building diagnosis and repair encyclopedia providing photo guides, inspection techniques, and historical references for identifying building age, components, and restoration needs.

InspectApedia specializes in helping homeowners, inspectors, and restoration professionals identify building materials, architectural styles, and mechanical systems through detailed photo guides and historical references. The site emphasizes building age determination through component analysis and provides practical inspection and repair guidance for historic and contemporary homes.

## Key Topics

- Building age identification
- Historic homes inspection
- HVAC systems
- Electrical systems
- Plumbing fixtures
- Building materials history
- Architectural styles
- Wood framing construction
- Plaster and drywall systems
- Log home repair
- Kit homes
- Door hardware dating
- Electrical wiring types
- Heating equipment
- Building components

## Building Age & History Identification

- [How old is my building?](https://inspectapedia.com/Design/Age_of_Building.php): Guide to determining building age through components and materials
- [Historic houses: How to Identify & Inspect Historic Homes & Old Houses](https://inspectapedia.com/home_inspection/Historic-Home-Inspection.php): Inspection guide for identifying and evaluating historic homes
- [Architecture: Building Types & Component Identification Guide Home Page & Article Index](https://inspectapedia.com/Design/Building_Architecture.php): Photo guide to architectural styles and building component identification
- [Door Age: Door Locks, Knobs, Hinges Hardware as Indicators of Building Age](https://inspectapedia.com/interiors/Door_Age.php): Guide to dating buildings using door hardware and fixtures
- [Nail & Spike Age, History, Uses](https://inspectapedia.com/interiors/Nails_Hardware_Age.php): Historical guide to nail types and fabrication for building age dating

## Mechanical Systems & Equipment Age

- [Plumbing age, water heater age, plumbing fixture age: How to Determine the Age of a House and its Plumbing System](https://inspectapedia.com/plumbing/Age_of_Plumbing.php): Photo guide to determining plumbing system and fixture age
- [Age & Life of Heating Boilers & Furnaces](https://inspectapedia.com/heat/Age_Of_Heaters.php): Guide to reading heating equipment data tags and determining age
- [Air Conditioners: Air Conditioner Data: Air Conditioning & Heat Pump Data Tags De-Coded](https://inspectapedia.com/aircond/Data-Tag-Decoder-Air-Conditioner-Heat-Pump.php): Decoder guide for HVAC equipment data tags and specifications
- [Building Electrical Component Age](https://inspectapedia.com/electric/Electrical-Component-Age.php): Guide to determining age of electrical panels, wiring, and components

## Interior Materials & Wall Systems

- [Interior Wall Coverings A Guide to Building Age & Choices of Wall Sheathing or Coverings Indoors](https://inspectapedia.com/interiors/Interior_Wall_Covering_Choices.php): Guide to identifying plaster, drywall, and wall materials for age dating
- [Plaster Types & Methods in Buildings](https://inspectapedia.com/interiors/Plaster_Systems_in_Buildings.php): Guide to identifying and repairing plaster and drywall systems
- [Flooring, Age & components](https://inspectapedia.com/interiors/Age_of_Flooring.php): Guide to flooring material history and age determination

## Electrical Systems & Antique Equipment

- [Old Electrical Wiring History & Types](https://inspectapedia.com/electric/Old_Electrical_Wiring.php): Photo guide to historical electrical wiring types and safety issues
- [Antique Electrical Receptacles - Outlets Identify old electrical receptacles (wall plugs or outlets)](https://inspectapedia.com/electric/Antique-Old-Electrical-Receptacles.php): Identification and history guide for antique electrical outlets
- [Antique & Old Light Bulbs Photo Guide & Catalogs of Antique Lamps (Bulbs)](https://inspectapedia.com/electric/Antique-Light-Bulbs-Lamps-ID-History.php): Photo catalog for antique light bulb and lamp identification

## Structural Systems & Construction Reference

- [Wood framing tables, damage & repair: Wood frame construction specifications: spacing of framing members](https://inspectapedia.com/structure/Framing_Size_Spacing.php): Construction specifications and tables for wood framing sizing and spacing
- [Antique Log Home Repair](https://inspectapedia.com/structure/Antique_Log_Home_Guide.php): Inspection and repair guide for antique log homes and structures
- [Porch Column Repair Life](https://inspectapedia.com/exterior/Wood_Column_Repairs.php): Guide to inspecting and repairing wood porch columns
